system.description:
The thaumaturge dissolves their shape and pours it into dead matter, becoming an inanimate object of roughly their own mass, a television, perhaps, or a small bed.

On activation, choose an inanimate form of a mass roughly equal to your own; a handgun or a van is beyond your reach. You must spend a Willpower Trait if you wish to keep your senses and the ability to use Disciplines, though some Disciplines cannot be used while transformed. The object behaves exactly as a real one would, so harm done to it is done to you. The form lasts for the remainder of the night, and you may resume your true shape at will. Retest with Occult.
